episodes.title: Rep. Moulton defends claims tying Sen. Ed Markey to Jeffrey Epstein
episodes.description:
Congressman Seth Moulton has alleged Senator Ed Markey's name appears in Epstein-related files, a claim Markey has denied, calling it "unethical" and "the worst of all politics."
